sources.title: Llama (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Llama[a] (" Large Language Model Meta AI " serving as a backronym) is a family of large language models (LLMs) released by Meta AI starting in February 2023. [3] Llama models come in different sizes, ranging from 1 billion to 2 trillion parameters.
